author: MiniMuffin7470
body: Hello, I am an extremely big fan of your awesome server (especially Nexus! :) ) About a year ago, I got banned for using hacks on this awesome server. But, it wasn't me, it was a friend of mine who had my laptop at the time and i never knew he used hacks. when i got my laptop back, i tried going on avicus, but it said i was banned for using hacks. That day i rang my friend, but he lied and denied everything about hacks. if you don't believe me, i don't even know how to hack. I am so sorry for my idiotic friends behavior and i have been crying my eyeballs out ever since the ban. Could you please un ban me from this wonderful server. Thanks, Night_Fury7470
